about: The one licence rule for this component (hard rule 2; build plan package 0.4). Every installed package, shipped or development, must carry a licence on the permitted list, or be named below. An exception is the owner's written approval of one named package for one named use, recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md. It never covers another package with the same licence. Where a package offers a choice of licences ("A OR B"), it is accepted if one of the choices is on the permitted list, and that choice is the one taken. Each exception is entered at the version that was read when it was approved or last looked at; another version fails the check until someone has looked at it and changed the number here.

exceptions.build_packages_note: The eleven per-machine build packages that lightningcss 1.33.0 lists as its own optional dependencies, each named here exactly. Which one is installed depends on the machine. Each is accepted only at the same version and licence as lightningcss itself. No other package whose name begins with lightningcss- is covered.
